title.ko: hasta ahora he… · si hubiera… habría… · dijo que… · fue construido · aunque… · para + infinitivo
title.en: B1 final review: writing a longer text

explain.ko: B1의 핵심 문형을 복습합니다. 현재까지의 경험은 현재완료: Hasta ahora he viajado a tres países. 비현실 과거 조건은 Si hubiera salido antes, habría visto el amanecer. 간접화법은 시제를 한 단계 뒤로: Dijo que se mudaba la semana siguiente. 수동은 ser + 과거분사: El puente fue construido en 1990. 양보는 aunque, 목적은 para + 부정사, 습관 변화는 acostumbrarse a입니다. 의견은 En mi opinión, 정리는 En resumen, 끝인사는 Espero tu respuesta pronto로 씁니다.
explain.en: A review of the key B1 forms. Experience so far uses the present perfect: Hasta ahora he viajado a tres países. Unreal past conditions: Si hubiera salido antes, habría visto el amanecer. Reported speech shifts the tense back: Dijo que se mudaba la semana siguiente. Passive: ser + participle: El puente fue construido en 1990. Concession: aunque; purpose: para + infinitive; getting used to: acostumbrarse a. Opinion: En mi opinión; summary: En resumen; closing: Espero tu respuesta pronto.

trans.en: (Question) How have you been so far?

trans.en: (Question) What are you going to do next month?

options: Voy a empezar un proyecto nuevo.

lines.t: Bien. Hasta ahora he viajado a tres países y el mes que viene empieza un nuevo proyecto.
¡Qué bien! Si me hubiera preparado antes, habría podido ir contigo.
Vamos juntos la próxima vez. Espero tu respuesta pronto.

trans.ko:
A: 오랜만이야! 요즘 어떻게 지내?
B: 잘 지내. 지금까지 세 나라를 여행했고 다음 달에는 새 프로젝트가 시작돼.
A: 대단하다! 난 더 일찍 준비했더라면 같이 갈 수 있었을 텐데.
B: 다음엔 같이 가자. 곧 소식을 기다릴게.
trans.en:
A: Long time no see! How are you these days?
B: Fine. I've travelled to three countries so far, and a new project is starting next month.
A: Wow! If I had prepared earlier, I could have gone with you.
B: Let's go together next time. I look forward to hearing from you soon.

lines.t: Hola, soy Eva. Ya ha pasado un año desde que llegué a esta ciudad. Al principio se me hacía extraño, pero ahora ya me he acostumbrado. Mis compañeros son todos amables y el trabajo es gratificante. Aunque hay días cansados, no me arrepiento de esta decisión.

trans.ko: 안녕하세요, 에바입니다. 제가 이 도시에 온 지 벌써 1년이 되었습니다. 처음에는 낯설었지만 이제는 익숙해졌습니다. 직장 동료들은 모두 친절하고 업무도 보람이 있습니다. 비록 피곤한 날도 있지만 저는 이 선택을 후회하지 않습니다.
trans.en: Hello, this is Eva. It's already been a year since I came to this city. At first it felt strange, but now I've got used to it. My colleagues are all friendly and the work is rewarding. Although there are tiring days, I don't regret this choice.

questions.q: ¿Cuánto tiempo lleva Eva en la ciudad?

lines.t: Esta es la prueba oral de B1. ¿Qué hizo el fin de semana pasado?
¿Y qué planes tiene para el mes que viene?

trans.ko:

items.passage:
CARTA
Querida Ji-su:
¿Cómo estás? El mes pasado me mudé a un piso nuevo, mucho más grande que el anterior. Mi vecina, que es profesora, me dijo que la zona es muy segura. Si tienes tiempo, ven a verme. ¡Escríbeme pronto!

trans.ko:
편지
Dear Ji-su, How are you? Last month I moved to a new flat, which is much bigger than my old one. My neighbour, who is a teacher, said that the area is very safe. If you have time, come and visit me. Write soon!
trans.en:
LETTER
Dear Ji-su, How are you? Last month I moved to a new flat, which is much bigger than my old one. My neighbour, who is a teacher, said that the area is very safe. If you have time, come and visit me. Write soon!

items.passage: Mark lleva cinco años en la misma empresa. Ha oído que lo ascenderán pronto. Pero dijo que le preocupaba asumir más responsabilidad.

trans.ko: 마크는 지난 5년 동안 같은 회사에서 일했어요. 그는 곧 승진할 예정이라고 들었어요. 하지만 그는 더 많은 책임을 지는 것이 걱정된다고 말했어요.
trans.en: Mark has worked at the same company for five years. He has heard that he will be promoted soon. But he said he was worried about taking more responsibility.

prompt.ko: B1에서 배운 시제, 조건문, 수동태, 전달화법을 사용해 친구에게 보내는 6문장 안부 편지를 써 보세요.
prompt.en: Write a 6-sentence letter to a friend using the tenses, conditionals, passive and reported speech you learnt at B1.

task.model: Hola, ¿qué tal? El fin de semana pasado fui de excursión con mis amigos y nos divertimos mucho. Hasta ahora he viajado a tres países. Si hubiera salido antes, habría visto el amanecer desde la cima. Mi profesor dijo que el mes que viene empezaba un nuevo proyecto. Espero tu respuesta pronto.

model_trans.ko: 안녕, 잘 지내? 지난 주말에는 친구들과 등산을 갔고 정말 즐거웠어. 지금까지 나는 세 나라를 여행했어. 더 일찍 출발했더라면 정상에서 일출을 볼 수 있었을 거야. 선생님은 다음 달에 새 프로젝트가 시작된다고 말씀하셨어. 곧 소식을 기다릴게.
model_trans.en: Hi, how are you? Last weekend I went hiking with my friends and it was great fun. So far I've travelled to three countries. If I had left earlier, I would have seen the sunrise from the top. My teacher said that a new project was starting next month. I look forward to hearing from you soon.
